welcome.title: Mark what to change, then hand it to AI
welcome.lead: Annotate images and videos made by Claude Code or Codex, showing exactly where and what to change
welcome.step1.title: Add items
welcome.step1.body: Drag images, videos or folders into the window
welcome.step2.title: Annotate
welcome.step2.body: Drag on the canvas to draw a rectangle, or use the pin, pen or arrow, then write what to change
welcome.step3.title: Copy the notes
welcome.step3.body: Copy as Text for Claude Code or Codex; Copy as Images for web-based AI and chat apps
welcome.saved: Notes are saved automatically in the project's .sniptoss folder, where Claude Code and Codex can read them.
welcome.capture: To annotate something on screen, press {keys} to capture it, mark it up, then paste it to AI.
welcome.captureNoKey: To annotate something on screen, click Capture in the title bar, mark it up, then paste it to AI.
tour.tools.title: Mark what to change
tour.tools.body: Use the rectangle, pin, pen or arrow to mark what to change, then describe the change. For feedback that isn't about one spot, use Overall.
tour.panel.title: Notes panel
tour.panel.body: Notes are listed here by number, matching the marks on the canvas. When you're done, copy them at the bottom and hand them to AI.
tour.capture.title: Capture
tour.capture.body: To annotate something on screen, press {keys} to capture it, mark it up, then paste it to AI.
tour.capture.bodyNoKey: To annotate something on screen, click here to capture it, mark it up, then paste it to AI.
tour.skipTitle: Close the tour. You can take it again from Help → Feature Tour
hint.copy: When you're done, use Copy as Text for Claude Code or Codex, or Copy as Images for web-based AI and chat apps.
hint.drawing: A mark left without a note stays as a drawing: no number, and it's included in the snapshots. Click it to recolor or delete it; double-click to add a note.
hint.video: Marks on a video belong to the current frame, so pause on the frame you want to change first. For feedback about a moment rather than a spot, use Timestamped (T).
hint.screenAccess: Before using Screen Capture, allow {app} to record the screen.
library.empty.title: No items yet
library.empty.body: Items are grouped into projects by folder. Removing one from the list doesn't delete the file.
settings.ai.desc: Copy as Text gives each note's text and position, plus the local paths of the item and its snapshots; it's for AI that can read files on this computer, such as Claude Code and Codex. Copy as Images makes one image per note, for web-based AI and chat apps.
settings.ai.scope: What gets copied: the checked notes or, with nothing checked, every open note listed in the notes panel. Copying from a context menu copies only what you right-clicked: that note, item, folder or project.
panel.search.title: Search notes and replies (Ctrl F); separate keywords with spaces

settings.title: Settings
settings.general.title: General
settings.general.uiScaleDesc: Scales text and controls. The items themselves are not affected.
settings.general.backdropDesc: What fills the space around an item. Choose Solid when judging color.
settings.general.tray: Keep running in the tray when the window is closed
settings.general.tray.mac: Keep running in the menu bar when the window is closed
settings.general.trayDesc: The app stays in the background so the capture shortcut keeps working. To quit, choose Exit from the tray menu.
settings.general.trayDesc.mac: The app stays in the background so the capture shortcut keeps working. Click the Dock icon to reopen the window; press ⌘Q to quit.
settings.general.autostart: Start when you sign in to Windows
settings.general.autostartDesc: Starts in the tray without opening a window.
settings.general.autostartDesc.mac: Waits in the menu bar after you log in, without opening a window.
settings.general.initialOpen: The first item with open notes
settings.general.storageDesc: Notes are saved in the project's .sniptoss folder and move with it. AI agents working in the project can read them directly.
settings.general.storageMissing: This project has no notes yet, so the .sniptoss folder doesn't exist
settings.annotate.title: Annotations
settings.annotate.categoryDesc: Used for the first note on each item; later notes start with the previous note's category. Press Alt 1⁠–⁠4 to switch while typing.
settings.annotate.autoCompose: Open the note box after drawing a mark
settings.annotate.autoComposeDesc: When off, press Enter or click the draft in the notes panel to start typing.
settings.annotate.pause: Pause video when choosing an annotation tool
settings.annotate.pauseDesc: Pressing C, R, B, A or N during playback pauses on the current frame.
settings.annotate.loopDesc: You can also toggle it with the button on the playback bar or Ctrl L.
settings.annotate.timeFormatDesc: Timecode and frames need a constant frame rate (MP4, MOV); other videos show seconds. You can also click the time on the playback bar to switch. Display only: the text for AI always gives seconds, plus frame numbers when the frame rate is constant.
player.timeFormatTip: Click to switch between seconds, timecode and frames ({fps} fps)
player.timeFormatSeconds: Shown in seconds: the frame rate varies or can’t be read
player.stack: {count, plural, one {# note here} other {# notes here}}
settings.annotate.showResolved: Show resolved notes on the canvas
settings.annotate.showResolvedDesc: Done and won't-fix notes are shown dimmed.
settings.annotate.colorDesc: Default color of marks. To recolor a single mark, click it and pick a color, or press 1–8.
settings.capture.desc: Select any area of the screen, draw marks and write notes. When you finish, the image is copied to the clipboard, ready to paste into an AI tool or a chat app.
settings.capture.desc.mac: Select any area of the screen, draw marks and write notes. When you finish, the image is copied to the clipboard, ready to paste into an AI tool or a chat app.
settings.capture.hotkeyDesc: Works in any app. Click the box, then press the new combination; Backspace clears it.
settings.capture.hotkeyConflict: The same shortcut stops working in other apps. If that's a problem, choose a different one.
settings.capture.hotkeyTypes: {keys} types “{typed}” on this computer's keyboard layout. While it is the capture shortcut, that character can't be typed.
settings.capture.hide: Hide this window when starting a capture from it
settings.capture.hideDesc: Keeps this window out of the capture. Starting with the shortcut doesn't hide it.
settings.capture.notesDesc: Adds your numbered notes below the image. When off, the notes go to the clipboard as text, but apps such as Claude Code and Codex take only the image when pasting, so the notes may be lost.
settings.capture.folderMissing: The screenshot folder hasn't been created yet
settings.capture.accessOff: macOS hasn't allowed {app} to record the screen. Turn on {app} in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen & System Audio Recording (Screen Recording on macOS 14), then quit {app} and open it again.
settings.capture.accessOn: Allowed. macOS may ask again from time to time; choose Allow to keep capturing.
settings.hotkey.title: Click to record a new shortcut
settings.hotkey.recordingTitle: Press the new key combination (Esc or click elsewhere to cancel)
settings.ai.title: Copying
settings.ai.extraDesc: Appended to everything you copy, for example “Re-export after the changes and add _v2 to the file name”.
settings.system.title: System
settings.system.desc: These apply to the current Windows user only and are removed completely when turned off.
settings.system.desc.mac: These features are provided by macOS. No setup needed.
settings.system.openWithDesc: In Finder, right-click an image or video and choose Open With → {app}.
settings.system.shellDesc: Adds “Open with {app}” when you right-click folders, images and videos. On Windows 11 it's under “Show more options”.
settings.system.shellAdded: Added to the File Explorer context menu
settings.system.shellRemoved: Removed from the File Explorer context menu
settings.system.dropDesc: If a desktop shortcut was created during setup, drag files or folders onto it to open them.
settings.system.dropDesc.mac: Drag files or folders onto the app's Dock icon to open them.
settings.keys.title: Shortcuts
settings.keys.desc: Press ? to see this list anytime. Change the capture shortcut under Screen Capture; the others can't be customized yet.
settings.advanced.title: Advanced
settings.advanced.desc: You rarely need to change these.
settings.advanced.author: Author name
settings.advanced.authorDesc: Written to the author field of the notes file. Leave empty to use your Windows user name{name}.
settings.advanced.authorDesc.mac: Written to the author field of the notes file. Leave empty to use your macOS user name{name}.
settings.advanced.holdDesc: Hold C, R, B or A to use that tool temporarily; releasing returns to Select. When off, a single press switches tools.
settings.advanced.listDesc: Which files in added folders are listed. Files added individually are not affected.
settings.advanced.kind.moreDesc: {exts}. When on, the File Explorer context menu covers these formats too.
settings.advanced.skipPlaceholder: Type a name and press Enter
settings.advanced.reviewDesc: When on, done and won't-fix notes are listed at the end.
settings.advanced.shotSizeDesc: Longest side of each note's snapshot (saved in {dir}).
settings.advanced.shotFormatDesc: PNG is lossless; JPEG is much smaller and suits photos and video.
settings.about.title: About
settings.about.shellMismatch: The app version is {version}, which doesn't match the interface. Reinstall to fix this
settings.about.author: Author
settings.about.feedbackDesc: Please attach diagnostic info when reporting an issue. It contains only version and runtime details, with no file paths or personal information.

tool.point.tip: Pin: click to place a mark
tool.rect.tip: Rectangle: drag to mark an area
tool.arrow.tip: Arrow: drag to point at something

sc.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
sc.menus: Open a menu (or press Alt or F10, then the letter)
sc.capture.start: Start a screen capture (change in Settings)
sc.capture.select: Select a window / drag an area (arrow keys nudge it; Shift for 10 pixels)
sc.capture.draw: Rectangle / ellipse / arrow / pen (write a note after drawing; without one the mark stays as a drawing, Esc discards it)
sc.capture.notes: Pin / overall comment (Alt 1⁠–⁠4 switches category in the note box; Shift Enter for a new line)
sc.capture.color: Change color (of the selected mark, or of the marks you draw next)
sc.capture.delete: Delete the selected mark (deleting a note's last mark deletes the note)
sc.capture.done: Finish and copy the image (or Ctrl C, or double-click the selection; Ctrl Z undoes the last step)
sc.list.step: Previous / next row (Home / End jump to the first / last row)
sc.list.range: Extend the selection (or Shift-click; Ctrl-click adds or removes)
sc.list.clear: Clear the selection (or click empty space in the list)
sc.list.expand: Expand / collapse projects and folders (on an item row: step frames or switch items)
sc.list.open: Open an item, or expand / collapse a project or folder (Space on the current item plays / pauses)
sc.list.copy: Copy the selection's notes as text
sc.list.remove: Remove from the list (files are not deleted)
sc.list.menu: Open the menu for the current row (or press the Menu key)
sc.notes.holdHand: Use the hand temporarily; releasing returns to the previous tool
sc.notes.holdTools: Use that tool temporarily; releasing returns to Select (turn on in Settings → Advanced)
sc.notes.timed: Timestamped comment (about the current video frame, without a position)
sc.notes.folder: Folder comment (about every item in its folder)
sc.notes.save: Save the note (Shift Enter for a new line; Ctrl Enter when focus is outside the note box)
sc.notes.undoPlace: Remove the last mark (marks drawn while the note box is open belong to the same note)
sc.notes.copy: Copy as text (the checked notes, or every open note listed)
sc.notes.nudge: Nudge the selected mark by 1 pixel (hold Shift for 10 pixels)
sc.notes.editDelete: Edit / delete the selected note (Delete removes the checked notes, if any, or just one mark if you selected it on the canvas; Backspace also deletes)
sc.paste: Add from the clipboard: a copied image or files
sc.notes.undo: Undo (Ctrl Shift Z or Ctrl Y to redo)
sc.notes.cancel: Cancel / return to the Select tool
sc.canvas.fill: Fill the window (drag to see the rest)
sc.canvas.marks: Show / hide the marks on the canvas (the selected note's mark still shows)
sc.canvas.pan: Pan (or drag while holding H, or use the Hand tool)
sc.video.range: While writing a note: set the start / end of a time range (I / O alone when not typing)
app.save.busyLoop: The notes file keeps being changed by another program, so this change wasn't saved
app.add.exists: Already in the list; it has been selected
app.paste.empty: There's no image or file on the clipboard
app.paste.image: Added the image from the clipboard to Pasted Images
app.capture.hideOn: This window now hides when you start a capture from it
app.capture.hideOff: This window no longer hides when you start a capture from it
app.window.topmostOn: Always on top is on. Turn it off from the Window menu

cli.help:
sniptoss: read and update the notes in a project's .sniptoss folder, for AI agents. Notes are created in {app}.

Usage: sniptoss COMMAND [OPTIONS]

Commands:
  list                List notes (only open ones by default)
  review              Regenerate .sniptoss/REVIEW.md
  resolve ID          Mark a note as done; -m says what was changed
  wontfix ID          Mark a note as won't fix; -m says why

Options:
  --root DIR          Project folder (default: the current folder; looks upward for the nearest folder with .sniptoss, like git)
  --all               With list: include resolved notes
  --json              With list: print JSON
  -m, --message TEXT  Reply for resolve / wontfix
  --author NAME       Reply author (default: agent)
  -h, --help          Show this help
  -v, --version       Show the version
